reviews.snippet: I am giving stars purely on the basis of rest stop that we took to change our baby's diaper on the way. Since this was rated as a good restaurant, we assumed washroom would be good. But alas! washroom didn't have water! After using washroom when we headed for the basin, there was no water! Very weird for a family place! We had thought of eating as well something here but then decided not to. Again, since we didn't have food, cant comment on that but a dining place on the highway is supposed to have water in the washroom. Basic requirement!

reviews.snippet:
Very bad experience. Pls avoid.
The restaurant is very poorly maintained.
Very bad customer service, felt like they don't want any customers there. ACs were not working. The whole restaurant smelling of rotting wood.
The wait was too long even though the restaurant was empty. They even gave us items that we didn't order and billed us.
In the end, there was no water in the washroom.
They don't care about the most basic requirements for their customers. It was a really bad experience.
